# Pull request

## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete issue and how this change addresses it.

## Scope and evidence

Link related issues and actual implementation evidence. State which projects remain Planned.

## Validation

List commands run, results and checks not run.

- [ ] Local documentation validation passes.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass, or absence of application changes is explained.
- [ ] Relative links and diagrams were reviewed.
- [ ] English and Portuguese READMEs remain consistent where affected.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or unauthorized assets are included.
- [ ] Security implications and integration compatibility were reviewed.
- [ ] Status claims match verifiable evidence.
- [ ] Changelog and documentation are updated where applicable.
